law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (Official Gazette of RS No. 104/2009, as amended to 66/2019)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous/pseudonymous works: 70 years from lawful publication)
moral_rights: Attribution & integrity (heirs may assert after death)
orphan_works: Provisions on anonymous and orphan works (2026 draft law would align with Directive 2012/28/EU)
digital_protection: Technological protection measures; holders must enable lawful uses (2012 amendments)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list: private non-commercial copying, quotation, teaching, libraries, news reporting
registration_required: No (voluntary recording and deposit with IP Office)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Office of the Republic of Serbia (Copyright and Related Rights Department)
